value.rationale: The published voter-reset model has a solved independent random memory. Correlated frozen memories are natural in spatially structured initial states. Exact control of when local voter imitation loses positive adjacent correlation to anticorrelated memory answers a genuine competition problem: a sharp minimum reset rate across all two-state Markov templates, one and only one inversion for each negative template, and an inverse-correlation asymptotic. This is more than a symbolic variant of the c=0 formula and is directly useful for interpreting domain-wall densities relative to independent-spin baseline.
residual_risks: No thermodynamic phase transition or claim for arbitrary initial memory correlations follows.
